description: ADA dental claim form: the ruled grid of the page is read as a form, not as one table (#281): each section bar is a heading, and the Contents lists them in the form's printed numbering (#163). Its 203 fields all render (#164). The missing-teeth chart (33) is two fieldsets of 16 check boxes under the chart's caption, each box named by its own tooth number, not 16 boxes that share the whole row of numbers as one name (#281).

heading.text: OTHER COVERAGE (Mark applicable box and complete items 5-11. If none, leave blank.)

toc_on_page: OTHER COVERAGE (Mark applicable box and complete items 5-11. If none, leave blank.)
POLICYHOLDER/SUBSCRIBER INFORMATION (For Insurance Company Named in #3)
BILLING DENTIST OR DENTAL ENTITY (Leave blank if dentist or dental entity is not submitting claim on behalf of the patient or insured/subscriber.)
TREATING DENTIST AND TREATMENT LOCATION INFORMATION

field_group.legend: 33. Missing Teeth Information (Place an “X” on each missing tooth.)
